blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China – First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos joined the spouses of Asia-Pacific leaders during a cultural exhibition hosted by Chinese First Lady Peng Liyuan on the sidelines of the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders’ Meeting on Thursday. The guests visited Shenzhen Bay Culture Square, where they watched traditional Chinese performances, including the Xingshi, or awakening lion performance, and the Yingge dance presented by a group of children.
